chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Ibn Abi Najran, from Hammad al-Nab, from al-Mismai who said:

When Dawud ibn Ali arrested al-Mualla ibn Khunays, imprisoned him, and wanted to kill him, al-Mualla ibn Khunays said to him: Take me out to the people, for I have much debt and wealth, so that I may bear witness to that. So he took him out to the market, and when the people had gathered, he said: O people, I am al-Mualla ibn Khunays, whoever knows me has known me. Bear witness that what I leave of wealth, whether in kind, or debt, or a slave-girl, or a slave, or a house, whether little or much, is for Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him). He said: Then Dawud's head of security struck him and killed him.

He said: When that reached Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), he came out dragging his cloak until he entered upon Dawud ibn Ali, with his son Ismail behind him, and said: O Dawud, you killed my Mawla and took my property. He said: I did not kill him, nor did I take your property. He said: By Allah, I will surely supplicate Allah against the one who killed my Mawla and took my property. He said: I did not kill him, but it was my head of security who killed him. He said: By your permission or without your permission? He said: Without my permission. He said: O Ismail, have your way with him. He said: So Ismail came out with the sword and killed him in his seat.

Hammad, from al-Mismai, from al-Mu'tab who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) remained in prostration and standing throughout the night. I heard him at the end of the night while in prostration calling out: O Allah, I ask You by Your strong power, and by Your overpowering awe, and by Your might for which You created the abased, that You bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and that You take him this moment. He said: By Allah, he did not raise his head from his prostration until we heard the cry, and they said: Dawud ibn Ali has died. Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: I supplicated Allah against him with a supplication due to which Allah sent an angel to him who struck his head with a hammer, and his bladder split from it.

key_terms.الْمَعَلَّى بْنُ خُنَيْسٍ: al-Mualla ibn Khunays, a companion who declared his wealth to the Imam
key_terms.دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: Dawud ibn Ali, the governor of Medina
key_terms.لَيْلَتَهُ سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا: He remained in prostration and standing (throughout the night)

ai.seo_question: What is the story of al-Mualla ibn Khunays and his declaration of wealth to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This narrative from Rijal al-Kashshi recounts the death of al-Mualla ibn Khunays, who declared his wealth belonged to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq before being killed by Dawud ibn Ali's guard. The Imam then went to Dawud, confirmed the guard acted without permission, and sent his son Ismail to kill him. The Imam spent the night in prostration supplicating for Dawud's death, which occurred immediately after his du'a, fulfilling the prophecy of an angel striking him.

en.ammaar-muslim: 2. [2/262] Rijal al-Kashshi: Ibn Abi Najran from Hammad al-Nab from al-Mismai who said:

When Dawud b. Ali [the governor of Madina] arrested al-Mualla b. Khunays, imprisoned him, and wanted to kill him – Mualla b. Khunays said to him: take me out to the people first, for I have a lot of debts and wealth which I want to declare, so he took him out to the market. When the people had gathered he [Mualla] said: O people, I am Mualla b. Khunays, whoever knows me has known me. I bear witness that what I leave of wealth, or debt, or slave-girl, or house, or less or more, then it is is for Ja`far b. Muhammad عليه السلام. He [al-Misma`i] said: then Dawud’s head of security struck him and killed him.

When the news reached Aba Abdillah عليه السلام he came out dragging his cloak [on the ground – in his hurry] until he entered upon Dawud b. Ali with his son Ismail behind him and said: Dawud you killed my Mawla [client] and usurped my property?! He said: I did not kill him nor have I taken your property. He said: By Allah I am going to pray to Allah against the one who killed my Mawla and took my property! He [Dawud] said: I did not kill him – it was the head of my guards. He [the Imam] said: by your permission or without? He [Dawud] said: without my permission. He [al-Sadiq] said: O Ismail have your way with him! he [al-Mismai] said: so Ismail came out with a sword and killed him in his seating place.

Hammad from al-Mismai from Muattib who said: Abu Abdillah عليه السلام remained standing in worship and in prostration the whole night. I heard him calling out near the end of the night whilst in prostration: O Allah, I ask you by your irrepressible strength, and your over-powering awe, and by your might in the face of which your creatures are abased, that you bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad and that you take him this moment! He [Muattib] said: by Allah he [the Imam] had not raised his head from the prostration when we heard a cry and they said Dawud b. Ali has died. Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said: I supplicated against him to Allah with a supplication due to which Allah sent him an angel who struck his head with a hammer and caused his bladder to split.
